name: WT p53 (17-29)
notes: Already in config/peptides.yaml. Anchor assignment verified against 1YCR geometry.

name: p53 (15-29)
notes: Construct used by Lang & Perez 2021. Two extra N-terminal residues vs p53_17_29; needs ref_residue_range or a padded reference to align to 1YCR chain B.

name: p53 (18-29) capped
notes: Murray & Gellman Figure 3 compound 1. N-acetyl / C-amide capped in the assay; BioEmu would sample the uncapped sequence.

name: p53 hexapeptide (18-23)
notes: Only two of three anchors present. Useful as a weak-binder control but C3 cannot be scored on three anchors.

name: pDIQ
notes: ANCHORS CORRECTED: config/peptides.yaml currently says 3,6,10. W7 sits 2.35 A from the Trp pocket centre in 3JZS; W6 sits 8.88 A. See README Finding 1.

name: PMI
notes: Crystal chain B resolves 11 residues (TSFAEYWNLLS); config ref_residue_range [1,11] is correct.

name: Ala1 anchor control
notes: Anchor triad on a poly-Ala background. Tests whether anchors alone produce bound-like conformations. Expect HIGH dG_conf.

name: Ala2 null control
notes: No anchors at all. Hard negative. Expect the HIGHEST dG_conf of the set. Note poly-Ala is intrinsically helical, so C2/C5 may pass while C3/C4 must fail.

name: ATSP-7041
notes: Contains R8, Cba, S5 and a hydrocarbon staple. BioEmu accepts only the 20 standard residues, so this cannot be run. Listed to document the exclusion.

name: Novartis phage peptide 2
notes: Needs a bound reference structure or a model before it can be scored.

name: Novartis truncation 3
notes: Needs a bound reference structure. Useful because it is a 28-fold-weaker truncation of nov2.

name: aPP scaffold
notes: Parent scaffold with no MDM2 anchors. Folded-state reference for the miniprotein series.

name: Miniprotein 59
notes: Schepartz aPP graft. Folded scaffold should give LOW dG_conf.

name: Miniprotein 60
notes: Most potent of the miniprotein series.

name: Miniprotein 61
notes: KEY PAIR: identical helix sequence to mini59, only the polyproline-II segment differs (GKSWMTVP vs GPSQPTYP). 47-fold weaker. Interface is matched, so the affinity difference should be almost entirely conformational. Best available positive test for dG_conf.
